response.answer: I take ownership of murky vendor incidents by establishing a clear evidence base, separating verified contract facts from vendor claims, and coordinating communications without overstating attribution. I share undisputed facts promptly, but hold attributed statements—verbally and in writing—until the relevant export or equivalent evidence is available; where the vendor has explicitly admitted fault, I communicate that same day. I also address record issues at their source and document the rationale for communications. This is supported by my handling of the November vendor outage, the evidence-gated attribution rule I adopted afterward, and a later source-level correction to export records. The record supports this evidence-led approach, rather than a claim that I independently resolved every vendor incident end-to-end.
